facts.fact: 惊喜迎婴派对：她航班延误，他先在会场备战
facts.anchor: Logan had texted earlier in the day to let me know her flight had been delayed

facts.fact: Georgia用app追踪朋友们位置（girls’ trip时给的授权）
facts.anchor: They gave me permission a few years ago when we went on a girls’ trip.

facts.fact: 他为见她跑步上楼——与时间无关
facts.anchor: It was because I couldn’t wait a second longer to see her.

facts.fact: 重逢第一眼：奶油色连衣裙、巧克力长发，心里就一个词Mine
facts.anchor: Her hair spilled down her back like molten chocolate

facts.fact: 相拥——几个月来第一次能完整呼吸
facts.anchor: For the first time in months, I could breathe fully.

facts.fact: 电梯镜面对视：像开球前最后几秒
facts.anchor: It felt like the last few seconds before the start of a game. Electric. Full of potential.

facts.fact: 家族之痛：怕父母缺席婚礼、见不到孙辈
facts.anchor: What if they never met their grandchildren?

facts.fact: therapy认知：父母的爱是有条件的
facts.anchor: It had taken me lots of therapy to realize that my parents’ love had been conditional

facts.fact: 高跟鞋哲学：显高显性感，代价是跟腱
facts.anchor: “Because they make me feel tall and sexy—at least when they aren’t making my Achilles feel weak.”

facts.fact: 外卖回他家：感觉normal/domestic，像偷来的日常
她的底线重申：目前太专注事业
facts.anchor: But for now, I’m too focused on my career to give a relationship the attention it deserves.

facts.fact: 他的coworker时刻：脱口说邀请你来是个错误
facts.anchor: “Maybe it was a mistake to invite you here,”

facts.fact: 他坦白：越相处越想做reckless的事
facts.anchor: The more time we spend together, the more tempted I am to do something reckless.

facts.fact: 她的反提案：one-time thing、周末后回到从前、no strings
facts.anchor: it’s a one-time thing. After this weekend, we go back to the way things were.

facts.fact: 他的反问：如果我不要一夜、要strings、要more呢？
facts.anchor: What if I don’t want just one night?

facts.fact: 初吻：久旱后的第一场雨
facts.anchor: It felt like that first rain after a long drought
